# XY Forever serial protocol 1.17: events, developer commands, reserved

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.17](../PROTOCOL.md).

## Events

### 0xd0 `log`

A progress line while `boot.install` or `boot.uninstall` runs.

Sent with seq 0 while an install writes the boot partition, as long as the tool keeps reading (the device stops sending after the first line that cannot be
delivered). Lines like `xyf install step N value 0x...` mark the install's steps.

Payload (8 to 208 bytes):

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `zero` | u32 | always 0 |
| `ms` | u32 | device milliseconds since its service started |
| `text` | text ASCII, 0..200 B | ASCII, no NUL, at most `max_log_text` bytes |

## Appendix: developer commands

Unstable: they may change or disappear in any version, outside the compatibility rules.

### 0x02 `diag.status`

Device counters as tagged binary blocks. Development aid: the USB service's counters, the processor link, the file server, boot timing and the last dry-run
boot.

Request: empty (the device ignores any payload).

| Reply field, after the status (0 to 4092 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `blocks` | rest, 0..4092 B | a sequence of blocks `{u32 magic, u32 bytes, bytes...}`; the block layouts belong to the build (decoder: `xy_forever/census.py`) and change without notice |

On an error: the status only. Errors: none of its own. The reply never gains fields (it ends in `rest`). Tool timeout: 5 s. Since 1.0.

Types 0x05, 0x07, 0x34, 0x42 are internal test commands, described only in the spec file; tools must not send them.

## Reserved for later versions

Numbers reserved for later items, and retired numbers that are never used again. Not answered by any build: nothing here exists on the wire. Types 0x33..0x33:
retired, never reused: the test command `diag.guard` until 1.13 (the watchdog guard was removed in 1.14). Types 0x60..0x60: retired, never reused: the test
command `diag.hang` until 1.13. Types 0x61..0x7f: new developer commands. Types 0xd0..0xdf: events, seq 0 (0xD0 is log today; progress 0xD1 with #14).
